rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for stretching as a physical exercise.

example.english: I do a few minutes of stretching every morning.
example.traditional: 我每日朝早都會做幾分鐘拉筋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 zou6 gei2 fan1 zung1 laai1 gan1

rows.note: Use this for the act or process of stretching a material, rather than for exercise.

example.english: This piece of cloth needs stretching before it can be sewn.
example.traditional: 呢塊布要先拉伸，先至可以縫。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 bou3 jiu3 sin1 laai1 san1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 fung4
